ENGL 2010.title: Intermediate Academic Writing
ENGL 2010.prereqText: Appropriate ACT test scores taken within the last three years or completion of ENGL 1010 or ENGL 1010H with a grade of C- or higher, or ENGH 1005 with a grade of C or higher.

MATH 1050.title: College Algebra
MATH 1050.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 2000.prereqText: Within the past two years, one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or an appropriate math placement score.

MATH 2010.title: Mathematics for Elementary Teachers I
MATH 2010.prereqText: Within the past two years: MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 or MATH 2000 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

admissionInfo.note: Students must complete all Pre-Professional and General Education courses with an overall GPA of 2.7 before they are formally admitted into the Teacher Preparation Program.
admissionInfo.text: Admissions Requirements: 1. Reading and Writing--Complete ENGL 2010 with a B- or higher 2. Mathematics--Complete MATH 1050, 1055, or 2000 with a C or higher 3. GPA of 2.7 or higher 4. General Education coursework completed 5. Completion of Pre-Professional Core Requirements with a B- or higher (Math courses C or higher) 6. Pass LiveScan Criminal Background Check
